title: VE Data Science Reports
text: Progress reports for the ve_data_science repository.

title: Soil and Litter GitHub Issues Tracker
text:
This two weeks, I merged PRs #387 (addressing #381) and #379 (addressing #372), generalizing litter and soil input data scripts beyond Maliau. I also merged #366 to implement derived variable functions, fulfilling #346, and completed initial SAFE soil input data stage 1 (via #374). My near-term focus is preparing soil and litter input data for SAFE logged forests (#389), specifically addressing various nutrient pools (#390-#393) and belowground litter pools (#394), alongside determining the appropriate logging intensity representation (#397). I also merged PR #411 to update soil layer depth terminology and PR #407 to reorganize the notebook folder. I also merged PR #371 to demonstrate R-based Zarr input/output, PR #387 (resolving #381) to generalize litter input scripts, and PR #366 (resolving #346) to implement derived variable functions. I plan to utilize these newly integrated derived variable calculations and reorganized notebooks in my upcoming data processing workflows.
